defect: MicroClayRetrieval._credit_tx joined an already-open UnifiedDB transaction without an inner rollback boundary. A later feedback-receipt insertion failure caught by the outer caller could allow earlier policy-capital mutations to survive when the outer transaction commits.
repair: Standalone credit keeps UnifiedDB.tx(). Credit inside an existing transaction now opens a unique SQLite SAVEPOINT, rolls back/releases it on any exception, and releases it on success.
regression: test_caught_inner_credit_failure_rolls_back_its_savepoint_only injects a retrieval_feedback insert ABORT, catches it inside a live outer transaction, requires zero policy/feedback leakage while an unrelated outer write still commits, then verifies one clean retry and duplicate idempotency.
